svg.title: fountain 模块依赖关系 / Module dependencies
svg.text: fountain 模块依赖关系 / Module dependencies
箭头 A → B：A 依赖 B｜43 个模块 / 234 条直连（结构性 61、冗余直达 173）
Arrow A → B: A depends on B | 43 modules / 234 direct dependencies (61 structural, 173 redundant)
实线＝结构性依赖（无法由其它依赖间接到达），按来源模块配色：同色 = 同一模块的依赖
Solid = structural dependency (not reachable through other dependencies), colored by its source module (same color = same module)
虚线＝冗余直达（可由其它依赖间接到达，cjpm.toml 仍声明了它）；悬停节点可高亮它的全部直连
Dashed = redundant direct dependency (reachable through other dependencies, still in cjpm.toml); hover a node to highlight its edges
不含 fdemo、fcoder、frpcdemo 等示例应用
Demo applications (fdemo, fcoder, frpcdemo) are not included
结构性依赖 61 条 / structural
